verdict.rationale: llamafile ships an HTTP server exposing both an API and the llama.cpp Web UI at localhost:8080, so programmatic access exists alongside the UI. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI and CLI can do (e.g., chat or image upload), and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented UI/API feature parity, API reference/endpoint documentation, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that UI and CLI actions like image upload are available over the API.
